THE ROLE AMD is seeking a Director of Developer Integrated Marketing to lead the global marketing strategy and programs that acquire, activate, educate and engage developers across AMD’s growing AI ecosystem. Reporting to the Global Head of Developer Marketing, this is a highly visible leadership role at the intersection of AI, software, developer experience and marketing. This leader will lead an integrated global team responsible for translating AMD’s technology and business priorities into developer-first campaigns, experiences and programs that accelerate adoption of AMD AI platforms. The role will own the integrated developer marketing engine across the developer journey, from awareness and acquisition through hands-on experience, education, community engagement and platform adoption. This leader will work closely across AMD Marketing, Developer Relations, AI and software engineering, product and business teams, regional marketing, communications and strategic ecosystem partners to create one coordinated approach to developer growth. THE PERSON: You are a strategic, modern marketing leader who understands developers as both a technical audience and a critical driver of technology adoption. You combine strategic thinking with a strong focus on execution. You know how to build an integrated marketing engine across campaigns, content and editorial, digital, events, education, community, social, paid and earned media, and ecosystem partnerships while maintaining a clear focus on measurable business outcomes. You are comfortable operating in a highly technical environment and can translate complex AI, software and hardware technologies into compelling developer experiences and marketing programs. You are equally comfortable setting strategy with senior executives, working with engineering and Developer Relations teams, continuously improving how marketing engages and supports developers, and getting close enough to execution to ensure the work delivers. You thrive in ambiguity, move quickly, make clear tradeoffs and build alignment across complex organizations. You develop strong teams and leaders, create clarity around priorities, and know how to scale through others. Above all, you are passionate about developers and understand that earning developer trust requires authenticity, technical credibility, useful experiences and a relentless focus on reducing friction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Own AMD’s global Developer Integrated Marketing strategy, translating company, AI, software and product priorities into a unified developer marketing plan. Lead the integrated developer journey across acquisition, activation, education, community and ecosystem engagement, with a focus on accelerating AMD AI platform adoption. Build an integrated operating model across campaigns, editorial, events, education, social, community, paid, earned and ecosystem marketing, ensuring developer programs operate as one connected marketing engine rather than a collection of independent activities. Build and scale programs that create meaningful hands-on developer experiences across AMD technologies, including AI Dev Days, hackathons, developer cloud experiences, workshops, product experiences and other technical activations. Drive global developer acquisition and lifecycle marketing, growing high-quality developer audiences across priority segments and markets and moving them from awareness through activation and sustained engagement. Partner closely with Developer Relations and engineering to connect technical enablement with scalable marketing programs, ensuring developers have clear paths from discovery to building. Scale AMD’s developer education and enablement ecosystem through programs including AI Academy, learning experiences, certifications, playbooks and other technical content. Lead Integrated Editorial for Developer Marketing, creating a cohesive editorial strategy and operating model across AMD's technical audience channels. Partner across Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Communications, Social, Engineering and other content owners to create a coordinated editorial calendar, prioritize the stories that matter most to developers, and ensure content is technically credible, audience-relevant and connected to measurable developer outcomes. Build an audience-first developer content and editorial strategy across AMD.com, social, community, video, earned, paid and emerging channels, using developer insights, performance data and AI to continually improve relevance, discoverability, engagement and developer experience. Develop integrated programs with strategic ecosystem partners, open-source communities, frameworks, startups, universities and developer influencers to extend AMD’s reach and credibility. Lead AMD’s developer events marketing strategy, ensuring global and regional activations are connected to clear audience, adoption and business objectives rather than operating as standalone events. Lead and optimize AMD’s third-party agency ecosystem supporting Developer Marketing, including agency strategy, scopes of work, budget management, performance measurement and ongoing evaluation. Ensure agency partners operate as an extension of the AMD team, with clear accountability for outcomes, strong integration across programs and disciplined management of marketing investment. Establish clear measurement across the developer journey, including hands-on experiences, developer acquisition, activation, education, community growth, platform engagement and adoption. Use data to continually optimize investment, audience prioritization, channel mix and program performance. Lead annual and long-range planning for Developer Integrated Marketing, including strategy, organizational capability, investment priorities, agency resources and measurement. Build and lead a high-performing global team across integrated campaigns, events, editorial and content, social, digital, paid media, ecosystem programs and developer experiences. Develop leaders within the organization and create an operating model that drives clear ownership, accountability, prioritization and execution at scale. Serve as a senior marketing partner across AMD, working closely with executives and leaders across Marketing, AI, Developer Relations, Engineering, Product, Sales and regional organizations. Champion an outside-in, developer-first perspective across AMD, bringing developer insights into marketing strategy, product launches, experiences and company priorities. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Significant senior leadership experience in developer marketing, technology marketing, integrated marketing, developer relations, product marketing or a closely related field. Demonstrated experience building and leading global, multi-disciplinary marketing teams. Deep understanding of developer audiences, developer ecosystems and the ways developers discover, evaluate, learn and adopt technology platforms. Strong understanding of AI and modern software ecosystems. Experience marketing AI infrastructure, developer platforms, cloud services, semiconductors, software platforms or other highly technical products is strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to build integrated global marketing strategies spanning digital, content, lifecycle, paid media, events, community, social, education and ecosystem partnerships. Experience leading integrated editorial and content operations across multiple teams, channels and stakeholders, ideally for technical or developer audiences. Experience creating developer programs that drive measurable activation, usage or platform adoption rather than awareness alone. Strong analytical orientation with experience establishing KPIs, measurement frameworks and investment models tied to business outcomes. Significant experience managing external agencies, including agency selection, SOW development, budget management, performance accountability and optimization. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering, product, Developer Relations, sales, communications and marketing organizations. Experience working with developer communities, open-source ecosystems, startups, universities, AI frameworks, cloud providers or technology partners is highly desirable. Strong executive communication and influencing skills with the ability to create alignment across complex global organizations. Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, make tradeoffs, prioritize aggressively and translate strategy into execution. Experience using AI and emerging marketing technologies to improve audience insight, content creation, developer experience, measurement and marketing productivity. Demonstrated success attracting, developing and retaining high-performing teams. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred. MBA or other advanced degree is preferred but not required. Equivalent relevant experience will also be considered. LOCATION Austin, TX May also be considered in Santa Clara, CA This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. #LI-SF1 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. THE ROLE As a member of the Data Center Platform Engineering (DPEG) organization, the Lead Firmware Architect will define and drive the firmware architecture strategy for AMD's next-generation AI infrastructure platforms. This highly visible technical leadership role is responsible for shaping scalable, secure, and serviceable firmware solutions that enable hyperscale AI training and inference deployments. The successful candidate will work across silicon, platform hardware, systems architecture, software, security, and key hyperscale customers to develop rack-scale firmware architectures spanning BIOS, BMC, management controllers, telemetry, RAS, and platform security. This role requires a combination of deep hands-on technical expertise, architectural vision, and cross-functional leadership to bring world-class AI infrastructure solutions from concept to deployment. You will help define industry-leading firmware frameworks, influence emerging standards, and solve the most challenging system-level problems in large-scale AI deployments. THE PERSON You are an accomplished firmware architect with a passion for large-scale systems, platform innovation, and solving complex engineering challenges. You thrive at the intersection of silicon, firmware, hardware, and cloud infrastructure. You are equally comfortable defining long-term architectural roadmaps, debugging complex system interactions, and influencing cross-functional teams toward a common technical vision. You possess strong technical depth in embedded firmware, system architecture, security, and manageability technologies, along with a proven track record of delivering scalable products into production environments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define and drive the architecture of current and future AMD AI platform firmware solutions, spanning System management, telemetry, diagnostics, and serviceability. Architect scalable rack-level firmware frameworks optimized for hyperscale AI training and inference deployments. Lead firmware strategy and technical direction across platform bring-up, customer enablement, productization, and lifecycle management. Drive adoption of industry standards and emerging technologies including DMTF Redfish, SPDM, PLDM, MCTP, UEFI, ACPI, CXL, and OCP initiatives. Partner with silicon architecture teams to influence next-generation platform features, manageability capabilities, telemetry frameworks, and RAS implementations. Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and design assessments across firmware stacks. Define firmware interfaces between Control Plane, BMC, BIOS, GPUs, CPUs, network fabrics, and rack management infrastructure. Collaborate closely with hyperscale customers and ecosystem partners to drive platform requirements, feature development, and deployment readiness. Drive architectural decisions for fault management, telemetry collection, observability, diagnostics, and platform health monitoring. Mentor and develop engineering teams by establishing best practices for firmware architecture, secure development, code quality, and platform integration. Lead root cause analysis of complex system-level failures and translate operational learnings into scalable architectural improvements. Influence industry standards bodies and open-source communities to advance firmware technologies for AI infrastructure. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Extensive experience in firmware, embedded systems, platform architecture, or low-level systems software development. Proven experience architecting complex embedded firmware solutions across server, accelerator, networking, or data center platforms. Strong expertise in platform firmware technologies including: OpenBMC IPMI and DMTF standards such as Redfish Embedded Linux-based systems Deep understanding of server platform architecture, including: x86 processors and GPU-accelerated systems Memory subsystems, High-speed I/O architectures Data center networking Experience with modern AI infrastructure technologies such as: PCIe Gen5/Gen6 CXL, UALink, XGMI Accelerator fabrics Rack-scale architecture Experience designing firmware solutions for system management, telemetry, diagnostics, and RAS features in hyperscale environments. Hands-on experience debugging complex interactions across firmware, hardware, operating systems, drivers, and management software. Strong programming background in C/C++, embedded Linux, U-Boot, RTOS environments, and low-level system software. Experience with secure coding practices and static/dynamic analysis tools such as Coverity, Black Duck, or equivalent technologies. Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and influencing architectural decisions across multiple organizations. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science. WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING You will have the opportunity to influence the firmware architecture that powers some of the world's largest AI deployments. This role sits at the center of AMD's AI infrastructure strategy, shaping the technologies that enable next-generation accelerated computing at hyperscale. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: Join a results-oriented Test Engineering team where you’ll have a direct impact on the quality, cost, and time-to-market of AMD microprocessors. You’ll work across the product lifecycle, from understanding pre-silicon product features and developing characterization test plans to identifying coverage gaps and building the software and hardware infrastructure needed for execution. You’ll collaborate closely with Design and Platform Engineering teams, with opportunities to influence future test strategies and product improvements. Post-silicon, you’ll tackle complex microprocessor debug and characterization challenges involving silicon performance, yield, manufacturing processes, and device marginalities. Working across engineering teams, you’ll drive root-cause analysis, contribute to datasheet specifications, and identify improvements that enhance product performance, quality, and yield. THE PERSON: This position requires accountability for the quality and timeliness of outcomes within assigned projects or processes. The ideal candidate demonstrates problem-solving abilities through standard engineering methodologies and exercises independent judgment in complex technical decisions. Responsibilities include design and equivalent tasks within defined project scopes, covering test planning, creation, characterization, data analysis, and silicon debug for advanced process technologies. Key duties include the development and debugging of Automated Test Equipment (ATE) test patterns and flows, ensuring device testability and manufacturability from development through production phases, and implementing product improvement measures to reduce cost, increase yield, and resolve quality issues. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Deliver innovative product test solutions consisting of hardware, software, and test content to achieve cost and quality requirements of the product. Complete post-silicon characterization, product definition, and performance optimization, and enable the internal validation team and external customers through the delivery of prototype samples. Optimize the overall product cost structure to maximize AMD profitability. This can include, but is not limited to, optimization of product yield, test hardware costs, and test costs. Collaborate with hardware design engineers and other development teams to establish specifications for infrastructure required to support production test and debug. Participate in the cross-discipline design process, working with Product, Design, and HWI (Hardware Infrastructure) team members to develop optimized integrated solutions. Identify thermal and electrical design requirements for SoC products and develop and optimize test programs to enable operation across the manufacturing process window. Collect and analyze data to facilitate engineering decisions during silicon hardware development. Validate ATE hardware and software systems to ensure they meet program objectives and troubleshoot and root cause issues. Work with internal teams and external partners/customers to define and release an optimal mix of SoC product variants to meet customer needs while achieving internal manufacturing and cost requirements. Mentor team members from both a technical and leadership perspective to grow the next generation of technical leadership within AMD. Develop scalable infrastructure, automation, and standardization for multiple product lines. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Hands-on ATE (Automatic Test Equipment) test experience; Advantest V93K SMT8 experience preferred. Experience with SCAN, BIST, and functional ATE test pattern debug and characterization. Unix and Windows proficiency. Experience with AI and developing skills/agents. Transferable experience in semiconductors, requiring some combination of expertise in semiconductor design, architecture, product test, product engineering, semiconductor physics, and/or semiconductor manufacturing. Deep semiconductor testing expertise and subject matter expertise. Computer architecture experience, especially GPU architecture or x86 architecture. Silicon performance optimization techniques, especially those pertaining to power optimization, frequency maximization, and advanced performance management techniques. Experience developing Load Boards and Probe Cards. Knowledge of one or more scripting languages, such as Python. Practical experience in the development and deployment of AI/ML solutions for continuous improvement. Expertise with common development tools such as Git, VS Code, and Bash. Basic understanding of test pattern conversion methodology and tools. Strong leadership and communication skills, including data presentation. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering. THE ROLE: We are seeking a hands-on Platform Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure foundations that enable engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure products. This role will shape the internal developer platform across Kubernetes, observability, AI-enabled workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. You will work closely with software, DevOps, security, and AI/ML teams to turn platform capabilities into a simple and dependable developer experience. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between architecture decisions, production operations, automation, and practical enablement of partner teams. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Design, build, and operate scalable Kubernetes-based platform capabilities for development, test, and production workloads. Create reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, patterns, and automated workflows using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, or equivalent technologies. Develop and evolve platform observability: metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, service-level objectives, and operational runbooks. Improve platform reliability, capacity management, security posture, and cost efficiency through automation and data-driven operational practices. Build the infrastructure required to deploy, operate, observe, and govern AI/ML workloads, including model-serving, GPU-enabled compute, data-access, and workload-isolation patterns where applicable. Enable self-service for product and engineering teams through well-designed platform APIs, templates, documentation, golden paths, and CI/CD integrations. Partner with application, security, infrastructure, and AI teams to define platform standards and remove delivery bottlenecks. Investigate complex production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable preventative improvements. Contribute to technical roadmaps, architecture reviews, and engineering standards for the platform. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience designing internal developer platforms or large-scale shared infrastructure. Experience with Prometheus, Python, Bash, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo, Elastic, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable observability systems. Experience with IBM LSF and Netapp Storage Experience with GitOps operating models. Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, GPU scheduling, Kubernetes operators, or AI workload orchestration. Knowledge of platform security practices, including identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, image security, and supply-chain security. Experience with service mesh, API gateways, ingress, networking, or multi-cluster Kubernetes architectures. Experience implementing infrastructure as code using Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Ansible, or comparable tools. Practical experience with observability platforms and concepts, including metrics, logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLOs. amd-89121.text: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them. AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. THE ROLE We are seeking a seasoned technical leader to drive platform readiness and enablement for AMD's next-generation AI infrastructure and connectivity technologies. This Director-level role is responsible for shaping the strategy, execution, and cross-functional alignment required to bring industry-leading scale-up and scale-out solutions to market, with a focus on UA Link, PCI Express (PCIe), CXL, Ethernet, and high-performance AI/HPC systems. Working across silicon, firmware, software, platform engineering, validation, and ecosystem partners, you will lead the development and qualification of technologies that enable large-scale AI racks, accelerator clusters, and next-generation data center platforms. You will play a critical role in ensuring AMD delivers robust, scalable, and innovative connectivity solutions for CPUs, GPUs, accelerators, and AI infrastructure. THE PERSON You are an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, and data center system architectures. You will lead a global cross functional engineering organization while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and strategic execution across AMD's AI infrastructure portfolio. You combine strong technical judgment with proven organizational leadership, enabling you to influence technical direction, align diverse engineering teams, and successfully execute complex product initiatives. You thrive in highly collaborative environments, excel at building relationships across organizations, and have a demonstrated ability to scale impact through both technical leadership and people leadership. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define and drive AMD's strategy for platform readiness, qualification, and ecosystem enablement of next-generation connectivity technologies including UA Link, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and future scale-up and scale-out architectures. Lead cross-functional engineering initiatives spanning silicon design, architecture, firmware, software, systems, validation, and product organizations to ensure successful product execution and market readiness. Provide technical and organizational leadership across multiple teams, guiding key architectural decisions, risk management, execution priorities, and long-term technology investments. Partner with internal engineering teams, industry consortiums, strategic customers, and ecosystem partners to accelerate adoption of AMD connectivity solutions and AI infrastructure platforms. Establish scalable validation and qualification strategies, ensuring readiness from pre-silicon development through system bring-up, production qualification, and customer deployment. Represent AMD in executive reviews, cross-functional technical forums, and strategic planning discussions, serving as a trusted technical leader for AI infrastructure and connectivity technologies. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Extensive experience leading server, data center, AI, or HPC platform architecture, systems engineering, validation, or product development organizations. Deep understanding of modern connectivity and interconnect technologies including UA Link, PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL, Ethernet, high-speed SerDes, coherent fabrics, and large-scale distributed computing systems. Proven track record delivering complex products from architecture definition through silicon development, platform bring-up, qualification, customer enablement, and production launch. Experience collaborating across architecture, design, validation, firmware, software, manufacturing, and customer-facing organizations while influencing technical direction across multiple teams and stakeholders. Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and leading high-performing engineering teams, with the ability to drive execution through both direct leadership and organizational influence. amd-87703.text: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. THE ROLE: We are hiring a AI Research Scientist, Hardware AI Systems, to develop AI systems that generalize across hardware engineering contexts, different SoC programs, toolchains, process nodes, and teams, without bespoke retraining for every program. You will work on metareasoning (when to call which tool or simulator), representation learning across flows (RTL, verification, physical design), and learning under high- or mixed-latency rewards typical of silicon signoff. You partner with methodology and silicon teams to turn one-off wins into reusable models, benchmarks, and transfer protocols that compound across AMD’s roadmap. amd-94383.text: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: AMD is seeking a Staff Data Engineer within the Marketing Analytics team to build and operationalize the data foundation that supports advanced analytics, data science, and machine learning across Marketing. This person will lead the hands-on development of scalable data pipelines, canonical data models, and trusted, reusable datasets that enable analytical use cases—from lead and account scoring to attribution, segmentation, forecasting, and campaign optimization. The role will work closely with data scientists, analytics professionals, Marketing stakeholders, and enterprise technology teams to translate analytical requirements into reliable data solutions. Responsibilities include integrating internal and external data through APIs and other ingestion methods, engineering datasets within environments such as Snowflake or Databricks, and establishing the data workflows, quality controls, and documentation needed to support repeatable model development and ongoing machine learning operations. THE PERSON: The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineering leader who combines strong technical execution with an understanding of how data supports analytics and machine learning. They think beyond individual pipelines to build reusable data assets with consistent definitions, clear relationships, and reliable historical context. They must be comfortable working with complex, fragmented data, translating analytical needs into practical engineering requirements, and balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability and scale. They must also be a collaborative problem-solver who builds trusted relationships across business and technical teams, communicates trade-offs clearly, and brings discipline to data quality, documentation, and delivery. The ability to guide and mentor engineers while remaining closely involved in solution design and development is important to success in this role. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Build and operate scalable marketing data pipelines, transforming data from internal platforms and external sources into reliable, analysis-ready and machine-learning-ready datasets within Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable cloud data environments. Develop reusable API integrations and ingestion frameworks to bring together CRM, marketing automation, digital analytics, media, event, partner, and other relevant data, with appropriate controls for incremental updates, schema changes, failures, and reprocessing. Design and maintain canonical datasets and shared data models, establishing consistent definitions, identifiers, relationships, and historical views across core marketing entities such as accounts, contacts, leads, campaigns, engagement, spend, and opportunities. Engineer datasets for machine learning and data science, partnering with data scientists to develop features, labels, and training, validation, testing, and inference datasets. Apply appropriate historical snapshots and point-in-time logic to support reproducibility and prevent data leakage. Lead hands-on engineering delivery and continuous improvement, managing priorities and dependencies, reviewing technical designs and code, mentoring engineers, and improving development practices through reusable components, automated testing, and disciplined release management. Establish data quality, observability, and operational reliability, implementing automated validation, pipeline monitoring, freshness checks, and controls for schema and data distribution changes. Troubleshoot issues and improve pipeline performance, recovery processes, and compute efficiency. Partner with Marketing, Analytics, Data Science, Sales Operations, and IT to understand business priorities, translate use cases into data requirements, and align on dataset definitions, delivery expectations, and ownership. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data platform development, or a related discipline, including experience leading technical projects or small engineering teams. Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience developing production-grade data pipelines, transformations, and reusable engineering components. Experience with Spark or PySpark is a plus. Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable cloud data platforms, including data modeling, workload optimization, orchestration, and management of scalable analytical datasets. Demonstrated experience building API-based data integrations, including authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental extraction, retry logic, and schema evolution, along with familiarity with file-based and other ingestion approaches. Experience preparing data for machine learning and data science workflows, including feature engineering pipelines, label generation, point-in-time-correct datasets, training and inference consistency, and reproducible dataset creation. Familiarity with feature stores and dataset versioning is preferred. Familiarity with MLOps and modern data engineering practices, including workflow orchestration, Git-based version control, automated testing, CI/CD, environment management, and the data requirements of model deployment and retraining. Experience with tools such as dbt or Airflow is a plus. Experience designing canonical data models and reusable data products, including entity resolution, deduplication, consistent data grain, historical tracking, and integration of structured and semi-structured data across multiple systems. Understanding of marketing and sales data ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, digital analytics, paid media, account-based marketing, events, and opportunity data, and how these sources support analytical and predictive use cases. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to translate business and analytical needs into engineering requirements, explain technical trade-offs, coordinate cross-functional delivery, and mentor technical colleagues. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: We are hiring ML Systems Research Engineers to build the reinforcement learning, inference, and evaluation infrastructure behind AI-for-engineering systems. This role focuses on the systems that let agents and models improve real engineering workflows: running many attempts, evaluating correctness, measuring performance, managing long-latency rewards, and feeding results back into model and agent improvement. You will work across compute optimization, hardware engineering automation, verification, simulation, debugging. The emphasis is on scalable ML systems that make research practical, repeatable, and useful for production engineering teams. THE PERSON: You are a systems-minded ML engineer or researcher who understands that model quality depends on the surrounding loop: data, tools, inference, graders, reward design, logging, and iteration speed. You can build reliable infrastructure, reason about RL and inference tradeoffs, and collaborate with scientists and applied engineers to make experiments reproducible and useful. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Build RL and inference systems for agentic engineering workflows, including job orchestration, sampling, scoring, caching, experiment tracking, and reproducible evaluation. Develop infrastructure for long-horizon and high-latency reward tasks where validation can take minutes to hours. Design staged rewards, proxy graders, sliced evaluation paths, retry strategies, and uncertainty-aware evaluation methods. Support optimization workflows with systems for candidate generation, benchmark execution, correctness checking, profiler feedback, reward modeling, and model-level improvement. Partner with AI research scientists on reward hacking research, reward shaping, metareasoning, and post-training methods for engineering tasks. Build scalable inference and tool-use pipelines for LLM agents that interact with compilers, profilers, simulators, formal tools, benchmark harnesses, and internal knowledge sources. Standardize datasets, eval definitions, run logs, leaderboards, failure taxonomies, and data collection for future training. Analyze experimental results and turn system behavior into actionable guidance for model, agent, tool, and reward improvements. TECHNICAL FOCUS AREAS Reinforcement learning and post-training infrastructure for tool-using agents. Inference systems for LLMs and agents, including latency, throughput, batching, sampling, reliability, and observability. Evaluation systems for tasks with expensive, delayed, mixed, or sparse rewards. Reward design for engineering domains where correctness, performance, quality, and resource usage must be balanced. Distributed experimentation, job orchestration, caching, data pipelines, dashboards, and reproducible run management. Integration with external tools such as compilers, profilers, simulators, validation systems, benchmark harnesses, and ticketing or knowledge systems. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Strong programming skills in Python and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, or similar. Experience building ML systems, RL infrastructure, inference services, agent frameworks, evaluation platforms, or distributed experimentation systems. Strong understanding of model inference, batching, sampling, latency, throughput, observability, and reliability tradeoffs. Ability to design experiments and evaluation pipelines with clear metrics, logs, reproducibility, and statistical discipline. 1Strong collaboration skills with AI researchers, applied engineers, infrastructure engineers, and hardware domain experts. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience with reinforcement learning, RLHF, GRPO, preference optimization, reward modeling, reward shaping, or post-training systems. Experience with LLM agents, tool-use systems, code generation, automated program repair, compiler optimization, or benchmark-driven development. Experience with distributed systems, job orchestration, Kubernetes, Ray, Slurm, workflow engines, data pipelines, or large-scale experiment management. Familiarity with GPU systems, ROCm/HIP, CUDA, profiling, kernel benchmarking, model serving, or distributed training/inference. Exposure to hardware engineering workflows such as design, verification, firmware, simulation, or performance analysis is a strong plus. Publications or shipped systems in ML systems, RL, inference optimization, AI infrastructure, or hardware/software co-design are valued. EDUCATION Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master's preferred; PhD is a plus, especially with work in ML systems, reinforcement learning, distributed systems, GPU computing, or AI infrastructure. amd-87598.text: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. THE ROLE: As a core member of the team, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and developing deep learning frameworks for AMD GPUs. Your expertise will be critical in enhancing GPU kernels, deep learning models, and training/inference performance across multi-GPU and multi-node systems. You will engage with both internal GPU library teams and open-source maintainers to ensure seamless integration of optimizations, utilizing cutting-edge compiler technologies and advanced engineering principles to drive continuous improvement. THE PERSON: Seeking an Industry Leading Expert C++ developer with advanced technical and analytical skills in Linux environments. The ideal candidate will excel in providing technical leadership, guiding teams, and driving projects/initiatives independently. You will define goals, scope, and own development efforts while collaborating effectively within a high-performing team. Develop GPU Kernels: Create and optimize GPU kernels to maximize performance for specific AI operations. Develop & Optimize Models: Design and optimize deep learning models specifically for AMD GPU performance. Collaborate with GPU Library Teams: Work closely with internal teams to analyze and improve training and inference performance on AMD GPUs. Collaborate with Open-Source Maintainers: Engage with framework maintainers to ensure code changes are aligned with requirements and integrated upstream. Work in Distributed Computing Environments: Optimize deep learning performance on both scale-up (multi-GPU) and scale-out (multi-node) systems. Utilize Cutting-Edge Compiler Tech: Leverage advanced compiler technologies to improve deep learning performance. Optimize Deep Learning Pipeline: Enhance the full pipeline, including integrating graph compilers. Software Engineering Best Practices: Apply sound engineering principles to ensure robust, maintainable solutions. Lead, Guide & Mentor: Provide strategic direction and mentorship to junior team members, fostering growth and collaboration through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: GPU Kernel Development & Optimization: Deep expertise in designing and optimizing GPU kernels for deep learning on AMD GPUs using HIP, CUDA, and assembly (ASM). Strong knowledge of AMD architectures (GCN, RDNA) and low-level programming to maximize performance for AI operations, leveraging tools like Compute Kernel (CK), CUTLASS, and Triton for multi-GPU and multi-platform performance. Deep Learning Integration: Proven ability and experience to integrate GPU-accelerated compute into ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), with a focus on throughput, scalability, and efficient execution for training and inference workloads. High-Performance Computing: Broad and indepth experience with large-scale, heterogeneous compute environments; adept at optimizing AI workloads for performance, efficiency, and resource utilization across clusters. Compiler Optimization: Thorough and detailed understanding of compiler internals, LLVM, and ROCm, with the ability to drive system-level optimizations from source to machine code. THE ROLE AMD is looking for a research engineer with practical implementation experience to advance AI-based medical imaging at the intersection of clinical imaging, deep learning, and high-performance computing on AMD platforms. You will work across the full medical imaging workflow, from data preparation and preprocessing through model inference, post-processing, and evaluation, investigating modern pipelines and optimizing their design and implementation on AMD platforms. You will build reference designs, GPU kernels, and agentic frameworks that let these pipelines run at maximum performance on AMD devices such as the Ryzen AI Max+ and Radeon AI Pro, with hardware–model co-design as a central theme: tailoring model architecture to the properties of the underlying hardware so that computation maps efficiently onto the device. Areas of interest include image reconstruction, segmentation, detection, classification, tracking, and quality assessment across modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, and X-ray. Working with AMD engineering and research teams, industry partners, and clinical collaborators, you will take imaging pipelines from problem definition through implementation, optimization, and evaluation; document your methods and results; and feed what you learn back to the libraries and kernel teams. Your findings will help establish the design frameworks and best practices for customers migrating imaging pipelines to AMD devices, and over time steer the team’s roadmap toward the co-design of next-generation imaging models: architected from the outset around AMD hardware for better mapping and efficiency. THE PERSON You bring a strong understanding of AI-based medical imaging and the programming skills to turn imaging models and algorithms into efficient software on AMD hardware. You have demonstrated experience writing code, profiling and tuning performance, and solving difficult technical problems. You can distinguish improvements that matter to a clinical imaging workflow running on device from gains in an isolated benchmark and communicate your findings clearly to both domain experts and systems engineers. We value depth in one or more relevant areas, curiosity across the clinical, algorithmic, and systems disciplines, and the ability to take ownership of a technical project from investigation to validated results. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Analyze modern AI-based medical imaging pipelines, understanding their clinical objectives, algorithms, computational requirements, and practical limitations. Collaborate with research and industry partners to design and build new AI models for medical imaging. Build or modify components of medical imaging pipelines across modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, and X-ray. Prepare, preprocess, and validate imaging data in coordination with the team’s data-handling and privacy procedures. Integrate and evaluate AI models for tasks such as reconstruction, segmentation, detection, classification, and tracking. Measure and profile model and pipeline performance against agreed metrics such as latency, throughput, occupancy, and memory use. Develop agentic frameworks that let domain experts target AMD devices more efficiently at the algorithm and graph-design level. Develop prototypes, scripts, tests, and technical documentation. Present findings and recommendations to internal teams, collaborators, and partners. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Strong programming skills in Python and experience with C++ or another language used for high-performance computing. Hands-on experience implementing machine learning or deep learning models for imaging applications. Experience with agentic design flows and AI coding tools such as Claude. Solid understanding of image processing and common medical imaging concepts. Experience profiling, debugging, and improving computational software. Ability to make progress independently while on a defined technical problem and collaborate effectively across medical and engineering disciplines. Clear written and verbal communication skills. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, or X-ray, in depth. Imaging libraries and formats such as SimpleITK, ITK, MONAI, OpenCV, DICOM, and NIfTI. Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including custom operators or distributed training and inference. Inference deployment and optimization with ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, ROCm, MIGraphX, HIP, CUDA, Triton, or comparable stacks. Real-time, embedded, or GPU-accelerated pipelines. GPU profiling and tuning of AI models to target GPU hardware more effectively. Clinical or regulated data workflows, demonstrated through research, coursework, or projects. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: This role entails improving quality and reliability of AMD’s industry‑leading Server CPUs and Instinct accelerators. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, test, yield, quality, and data science. You will work hands‑on with massive volumes of manufacturing and test data, transforming them into actionable insights and production‑ready analytics and machine‑learning solutions. You will develop, deploy, and use tools for analyzing test and reliability data, deploy advanced analytics that reduce DPPM (defective parts per million), detect excursions earlier, and optimize test time and cost at scale. This is a highly cross‑functional role where you will partner closely with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality/Reliability, and Operations teams, influencing decisions from early ramp through high‑volume manufacturing. The ideal candidate enjoys moving from exploration to deployment, and communicating results clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders. THE PERSON: You are a curious, analytical problem solver who thrives in complex, data‑rich environments. You enjoy uncovering patterns in noisy data and translating them into practical improvements that matter in production. You collaborate naturally across functions, influence without authority, and are comfortable balancing deep technical work with clear communication. You are equally effective working independently or as part of a fast‑paced, cross‑disciplinary team, and you take pride in building robust, reusable solutions that scale. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Partner with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Yield Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify, define, and prioritize analytics and machine‑learning use cases that materially improve yield, quality, and cost. Develop and deploy ML/AI solutions for parametric outlier screening, drift detection, and excursion/anomaly detection across wafer, lot, site, and package dimensions. Perform in‑depth root‑cause analysis of yield loss and DPPM drivers by correlating test, fab, assembly, and design variables; distinguish systemic issues from statistical noise. Build, productionize, and maintain yield and quality analytics within AMD’s AVA analytics platform, moving models from experimentation to scalable deployment. Drive adaptive test, screening, and binning strategies using data‑driven insights to optimize product quality and manufacturing efficiency. Author clear technical documentation and reports; present findings and recommendations to cross‑functional teams and executive audiences. Contribute reusable code, analytics frameworks, and best practices that elevate team capability and accelerate future development. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the adoption of AI-driven methodologies and tooling across our x86 Core Development Organization. This role spans the full pre-silicon lifecycle, including functional verification, RTL design, and physical design, and offers the opportunity to help transform how next-generation AMD x86 CPUs are developed. You will turn promising AI/ML approaches into scalable, repeatable programs that improve engineering efficiency and design quality. Rather than building isolated point solutions, you will help shape how AI is integrated into day-to-day core development workflows across the organization. You will define program goals, manage schedules and risks, and coordinate dependencies across design, verification, physical design, architecture, and data engineering teams. Partnering closely with the Cores leadership team, you will align priorities, track measurable efficiency and quality gains, and influence the broader AI adoption strategy for the organization. This role provides direct exposure to Cores leadership and the opportunity to collaborate with industry-leading engineers developing next-generation AMD x86 CPUs. It requires strong technical fluency in CPU core development flows and AI/ML methods, exceptional program management capabilities, and the ability to influence strategy and priorities at the leadership level. THE PERSON The ideal candidate combines technical credibility across CPU core development, including functional verification, RTL design, and/or physical design, with a working knowledge of AI/ML techniques and how they can be applied to engineering workflows. You are comfortable going deep into design and verification flows, model approaches, and tooling architecture while also establishing clarity, ownership, and predictable delivery across teams that may be new to AI-driven ways of working. You can translate complex technical opportunities into structured programs, align stakeholders across organizations, and drive measurable outcomes. You are motivated by the opportunity to lead meaningful transformation, work with cutting-edge technologies and resources, and contribute to a culture focused on continuous innovation. You want to influence how AI changes engineering work at scale while helping teams deliver higher-quality designs more efficiently. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Drive the definition and deployment of AI-enabled program strategies across verification, RTL design, and physical design within x86 core development. Identify and prioritize opportunities to apply machine learning, data analytics, and automation to engineering workflows (e.g., predictive coverage modeling, test/testbench generation, timing and congestion prediction, floorplan and place-and-route optimization, RTL code assistance, anomaly detection in regression and bring-up data, root-cause and failure triage). Develop program plans, define milestones, manage inter-team dependencies, and maintain program KPIs tied to verification velocity, coverage closure, PPA (power, performance, area) targets, and design-cycle schedule adherence. Coordinate cross-functional work across architecture, RTL/design, verification, DFT, physical design, performance modeling, and internal tooling/data engineering teams to build and scale intelligent workflows. Partner with EDA and internal tooling teams to define the infrastructure, data pipelines, and compute requirements needed to collect, clean, and analyze large volumes of simulation, coverage, timing, and layout data in support of AI/ML initiatives. Evaluate emerging AI tools and solutions (open-source, EDA-vendor, and internally built) for applicability across the core development lifecycle, and drive build-vs-buy recommendations. Identify, track, and mitigate program risks and issues; escalate when needed and drive corrective action with stakeholders. Facilitate effective communication and alignment across design, verification, and physical design teams, as well as with EDA partners and tool vendors; serve as primary program point-of-contact for AI adoption initiatives. Track and report measurable improvements in engineering efficiency and design quality — including verification velocity, coverage efficiency, bug/defect escape rate, and design-cycle throughput — resulting from AI-driven methods. Mentor and coordinate with engineering leads and other program managers to scale successful AI adoption pilots into repeatable, organization-wide practices. Support technical tradeoffs and prioritization discussions by preparing data-backed analyses, schedules, and impact assessments for engineering and executive leadership. Proactively identify risks, execution gaps, and systemic bottlenecks in the adoption of new methodologies; implement mitigation plans and hold teams accountable to closure. Facilitate stakeholder communication and present technical progress, risks, and tradeoffs to leadership with clarity. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Significant experience in CPU or SoC development, with hands-on background in one or more of: functional verification, RTL design, or physical design/implementation. Proven TPM or technical program leadership delivering complex, cross-functional programs end-to-end in ambiguous, fast-changing environments. Working knowledge of AI/ML or data science techniques and demonstrated experience applying them (or overseeing their application) to hardware design, verification, or EDA-related problems. Solid understanding of core development flows and tooling (e.g., simulation, regression, coverage collection and debug for verification; RTL/synthesis flows for design; timing, place-and-route, and physical verification for physical design), sufficient to credibly scope and prioritize AI initiatives across these domains. Demonstrated experience with program planning tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent) and agile delivery practices. Excellent stakeholder management, written and verbal communication, and presentation skills; comfortable engaging at both engineering and executive levels. Direct hands-on experience with Python and common ML frameworks/tooling (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) as applied to engineering or EDA data. Experience working with large datasets, relational databases, and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL, Tableau) in a silicon design or verification context. Prior experience developing or deploying ML models for EDA, verification, or physical design applications specifically. Familiarity with model training/monitoring tools (e.g., TensorBoard, MLflow, Weights & Biases) and reinforcement learning or active learning approaches in constrained engineering domains. Experience spanning more than one of verification, RTL design, and physical design, or experience leading programs that cut across multiple core-development disciplines. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: A master's or bachelor's degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering is desired. LOCATION: Fishkill, NY is preferred, open to other AMD locations THIS ROLE IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR VISA SPONSORSHIP #LI-AJ1 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. THE ROLE: AMD is looking for an experienced software engineer to help build Fleet Manager, a secure control plane for operating large-scale AMD GPU infrastructure. Fleet Manager provides scheduling, workload orchestration, hardware health management, interactive development environments, and model-serving capabilities across GPU clusters. You will design and build production systems spanning distributed control planes, Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, inference infrastructure, and developer-facing APIs and tools. You will join a team working at the intersection of systems software, cloud infrastructure, and accelerated computing. Your work will directly influence how engineers and customers train, serve, debug, and operate workloads on current and future AMD GPU platforms. THE PERSON: The ideal candidate is a hands-on systems engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and turning them into reliable, easy-to-use products. You have strong technical judgment, can reason about distributed-system failure modes, and are comfortable working across service, cluster, and hardware boundaries. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across organizations, and can lead substantial projects from architecture through production deployment. You care deeply about correctness, security, operability, and the experience of both end users and platform operators. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Design and develop Fleet Manager’s distributed control-plane services, APIs, schedulers, inference gateway, and command-line tools. Build reliable orchestration for GPU training, inference, custom jobs, and interactive development workloads. Develop scalable scheduling and admission-control capabilities, including priority, fairness, topology-aware placement, quotas, backfilling, and multi-node workload coordination. Implement durable reconciliation, lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and recovery across PostgreSQL and external execution systems. Integrate Fleet Manager with Kubernetes and technologies such as Kueue, JobSet, container runtimes, storage systems, and observability platforms. Help evolve Fleet Manager into a portable orchestration layer capable of supporting Kubernetes, Slurm, Spur, and future execution environments. Develop GPU health, diagnostics, quarantine, and controlled-remediation capabilities using ROCm and AMD hardware telemetry. Build secure multi-tenant infrastructure with strong authentication, authorization, workload isolation, auditing, rate limiting, and least-privilege defaults. Improve the reliability and performance of AI inference services, including routing, streaming, load shedding, health detection, and usage metering. Define and maintain stable APIs, data models, compatibility contracts, and operational procedures. Diagnose complex failures across distributed services, Kubernetes, networking, storage, GPU runtimes, drivers, and hardware. Develop automated unit, integration, failure-injection, and production-readiness tests. Work with AMD architecture, driver, platform, security, and machine-learning software teams to enable current and future GPU products. Participate in new GPU, system, cluster, and software-stack bring-up. Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and cross-functional problem solving. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Strong systems-software development experience in Rust, C++, Go, or a comparable language. Production Rust experience is highly desirable. Experience designing and operating distributed systems, control planes, schedulers, or cloud infrastructure. Strong understanding of concurrency, asynchronous programming, state machines, and failure recovery. Experience building reliable services using REST, streaming, WebSocket, or gRPC APIs. Experience with Kubernetes internals, controllers, operators, scheduling, resource management, or custom resources. Familiarity with workload scheduling technologies such as Kueue, JobSet, Slurm, or other batch and cluster schedulers. Experience with PostgreSQL-backed services, schema evolution, transactions, leader election, and optimistic concurrency. Experience developing command-line tools and stable, user-focused APIs. Understanding of container security, multi-tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, and secrets management. Experience with production observability, including metrics, structured logging, tracing, alerting, and incident diagnosis. Ability to write high-quality, maintainable code with careful attention to correctness, testing, and operational behavior. Experience with source control, continuous integration, automated testing, profiling, and debugging tools. Demonstrated ability to lead technically challenging projects and collaborate across organizational boundaries. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be beneficial but is not required: AMD GPU architecture, ROCm, HIP, amd-smi, RCCL, or GPU device plugins Distributed AI training and multi-node collective communication Large-model inference using platforms such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or similar runtimes GPU topology, capacity management, performance analysis, and hardware diagnostics Kubernetes networking, storage, admission control, and workload isolation OpenAI-compatible inference APIs, request routing, streaming, and rate limiting High-performance shared storage and large model or checkpoint management Bare-metal, virtualized, and cloud GPU infrastructure Production security and threat modeling for multi-tenant compute platforms PREFERRED ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. You will join a team working at the intersection of systems software, cloud infrastructure, and accelerated computing. Your work will directly influence how engineers and customers train, serve, debug, and operate workloads on current and future AMD GPU platforms. In this role, you will be at the forefront of optimizing and achieving peak performance for GPU clusters. The focus of this role is the RDMA networks used in AI Clusters, understanding data flows between GPU, NIC and cluster network. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in GPU architectures, parallel clustered computing, and hands-on experience in system level performance tuning and debug methodologies. THE PERSON: The team fosters and encourages continuous technical innovation to showcase successes as well as facilitate continuous career development. A seasoned professional who enjoys hands-on problem-solving. In this role, you’ll shape long-term strategy, drive feature enablement and jump in to tackle challenges head-on. You’ll have a direct impact on performance, automation, and validation, while staying ahead of industry trends to provide strategic insights to senior management. The person should be experienced in debugging complex HW/FW and clustered configurations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Scalability Testing: Evaluate the scalability of GPU clusters by conducting thorough testing under various workloads, ensuring optimal performance across different cluster sizes, configurations, and networking technologies (RoCE) Benchmarking and Analysis: Develop and execute comprehensive benchmarking strategies to assess baseline performance, analyze bottlenecks, and identify areas for improvement within GPU cluster environments. Cluster Network & Performance Optimization: Collaborate with hardware and software teams to enhance the overall performance of GPU clusters, focusing on aspects such as RDMA throughput, RoCE v2 network congestion, latency, and collective communications. Performance Profiling: Utilize profiling tools and methodologies to analyze and identify performance bottlenecks, providing actionable insights for improvement. Performance Tuning: Implement optimization strategies, including but not limited to protocol enhancements, load balancing techniques, and parallel processing optimizations. Documentation: Create detailed documentation of performance analysis, tuning efforts, and outcomes, providing clear and concise reports for internal teams and stakeholders. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software developers, and system architects, to integrate performance improvements into the GPU cluster architecture. Continuous Learning: Stay current with the latest developments in GPU architectures, parallel processing, and emerging technologies to drive continuous improvement in GPU cluster performance. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Proven experience in optimizing the performance of GPU clusters. RDMA network configuration, troubleshooting and performance tuning. Strong understanding of GPU architectures, parallel computing concepts, and network protocols. Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation and performance analysis. Experience with system level performance analysis tools and methodologies for GPU clusters. Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and debug skills. Familiarity with cluster management tools and systems. Excellent communication and collaboration skills for effective teamwork. Linux kernel networking expertise Machine learning and/or HPC system design ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelors or Master’s degree in computer science or electrical engineering LOCATION: Austin TX, Seattle WA, Santa Clara CA or Secaucus NJ This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. amd-89877.text: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them. AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced security technology leader who combines strategic thinking with strong technical execution. This role is responsible for defining and driving the enterprise security technology strategy, identifying capability gaps, evaluating emerging technologies, and delivering solutions that strengthen the organization's security posture. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with a bias for action. They are comfortable tackling complex security challenges, challenging conventional approaches, and driving innovation across organizational and technology boundaries to deliver measurable security outcomes. Success in this role requires the ability to assess security capabilities, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions through technology optimization, platform integration, automation, and targeted engineering efforts. Working across the security ecosystem, you will develop roadmaps, influence technology decisions, and translate complex security challenges into effective, scalable solutions that improve business and security outcomes. This role requires both strategic leadership and hands-on technical execution. THE PERSON You are comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels—setting long-term direction while remaining deeply involved in execution. You have led security engineering initiatives, influenced technology decisions, and built solutions that solved real security problems. In addition to broad security expertise, you have demonstrated experience developing custom capabilities, including automation, integrations, analytics, workflows, and AI-enabled tooling. You understand when to buy, when to extend existing platforms, and when building a solution delivers a meaningful advantage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define and lead the enterprise security technology strategy and roadmap. Evaluate the effectiveness of existing security capabilities and identify opportunities to improve coverage, efficiency, and resilience. Drive technology selection, integration, and optimization across the security ecosystem. Design and develop custom security solutions, automation, integrations, and AI-enabled capabilities where commercial products do not adequately meet business or security requirements. Establish a practical build-versus-buy strategy and lead implementation efforts when custom development is the preferred approach. Lead initiatives that leverage AI to enhance security operations, threat detection, security analytics, and exposure management. Establish and evolve security controls, governance, and operational practices that support enterprise AI and agentic systems. Partner with Security Architecture, Cyber Defense, Security Platform Operations, IT, and GRC teams to deliver scalable security capabilities. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership and key stakeholders. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Proven experience leading security engineering programs, security platform strategy, or enterprise security technology initiatives. Demonstrated track record of designing and building custom security solutions that delivered measurable operational or risk-reduction outcomes. Strong software engineering and automation experience, including development of security applications, integrations, workflows, data pipelines, analytics platforms, or AI-powered capabilities. Demonstrated experience building solutions that leverage security telemetry, operational data, and analytics to generate actionable insights, enhance detection and response capabilities, and enable data-informed security decisions. Proven ability to define security technology roadmaps and drive implementation from concept through operational adoption. Experience operating within large, complex, or rapidly evolving enterprise environments. Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics to security use cases. Familiarity with securing AI platforms, models, agents, and supporting infrastructure. Experience working with security telemetry, data pipelines, analytics platforms, or security data engineering. Ability to collaborate effectively with security architects and engineering teams to translate strategy into implementation. THE ROLE Lead the development, qualification, and manufacturing enablement of next-generation substrate technologies supporting AMD's advanced packaging roadmap. This role is focused on substrate process development, test vehicle strategy, yield optimization, process characterization, and rapid identification of technology risks during development and manufacturing ramp. You will drive substrate technology maturity from concept through high-volume production by developing process solutions, qualification methodologies, and test structures that accelerate learning cycles and improve manufacturing robustness. Will work closely with substrate suppliers, OSATs, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to enable industry-leading package substrate technologies with superior quality, yield, and reliability. THE PERSON The ideal candidate is a recognized technical leader with deep expertise in substrate manufacturing processes, test methodologies, materials interactions, process integration, failure analysis, yield engineering, and technology qualification. They possess a strong understanding of substrate fabrication processes and have successfully developed and industrialized advanced substrate technologies. They can complex manufacturing challenges through data-driven engineering approaches and have extensive experience partnering with suppliers to optimize yield, reliability, and process capability. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Substrate Process Development Lead development and qualification of advanced package substrate technologies for future AMD products. Drive process integration across substrate manufacturing flows, including imaging, lamination, via formation, metallization, plating, surface finish, and assembly interfaces. Define process capability requirements and technology readiness criteria for new substrate platforms. Develop and evaluate next-generation substrate materials and process innovations. Test Vehicle & Characterization Development Define substrate test vehicle strategies to evaluate technology capabilities, process margins, and manufacturability. Lead development of characterization methodologies for process capability assessment and technology qualification. Establish learning plans that accelerate process development and supplier technology readiness. Develop critical process monitors and technology health indicators.
